paper_title: A Faster Algorithm for Pigeonhole Equal Sums
classifications: Theory of computation → Design and analysis of algorithms
statement: Allcock et al. [1] proposed a modular variant of the Pigeonhole Equal Sums problem: given integers w1 , . . . , wn and a modulus m ≤ 2n − 1, find two distinct subsets A, B ⊆ [n] such that ∗ n/2 P P i∈A wi ≡ i∈B wi (mod m). They obtained a O (2 )-time algorithm for this problem. Can this result be improved as well? Can we obtain faster algorithms for other problems in PPP (e.g., [5, 21])?
